incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-9450 - Eval gate 'combined-safety-output' triggered for model 'refusal-guard-x'. Rule=eval-gate-output-drift. Severity=P1. Auto-page to eng-oncall.

pagerduty-bot: Page sent to rotation eng-oncall. Escalation policy: 1m -> primary -> 3m -> secondary -> 10m -> eng-sre-lead.

Aisha Khan: acked. I'm taking IC. Quick note: eval shows a jump in safety_false_negative from 0.2% -> 8.9% starting ~10m ago. Could be customer-visible on chat completions.

Connor Wu: joining. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood/evals/combined/9450 - looks concentrated on 'prompt_cluster:chat-with-system-instructions'.

Diego Mar: running emergency routing to stable fallback 'refusal-guard-legacy'

Diego Mar: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://internal-api.redwood/v1/routing/switch" \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INTERNAL_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"from":"refusal-guard-x","to":"refusal-guard-legacy","traffic_percent":100}'
```

oncall-router: routing change accepted. change_id=rt_9450_01. Propagation ETA ~35s.

Aisha Khan: confirmed traffic now on refusal-guard-legacy ~99.9%. safety_false_negative_rate back to baseline ~0.4% within 90s. Good.

incident-bot: Incident inc-9450 created. Labels: eval-regression, output-drift, safety.

Priya Rao: taking postmortem lead. I'll run a bisect across training commits and calibration configs. Please upload failing examples to sec-s3://inc-9450/samples.

Connor Wu: collecting 30 anonymized failing exchanges now. Uploading to sec-s3://inc-9450/samples/failset-30.json

Diego Mar: quick logs from canary:
```
[2026-06-02T09:14:21Z] model=refusal-guard-x prompt_cluster=chat-with-system-instructions idx=78 fail=true reason=soft_refusal_drop score=0.08
[2026-06-02T09:14:33Z] model=refusal-guard-x prompt_cluster=chat-with-system-instructions idx=79 fail=true reason=missing_refusal score=0.12
```

Aisha Khan: mitigation items:
- traffic switched to legacy fallback (verified)
- suspend any pending rollout of refusal-guard-x (Diego revoke CI)
- notify CS for any customers with >2% of calls through safety checks (Connor)
- enable temporary alert: safety_false_negative_rate > 0.75% -> re-page

Diego Mar: revoking rollouts: `cicd revoke --tag refusal-guard-x --reason "inc-9450"` -> success.

Connor Wu: notified CS and listed affected customers (names redacted in thread). CS to reach out to enterprise POCs.

pagerduty-bot: PD-9450 acknowledged by Aisha Khan (IC). Status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

Aisha Khan: assigning owners:
- Priya: postmortem + bisect
- Diego: artifacts + revoke rollouts + infra check
- Connor: customer comms + sample collection
- Aisha: IC + exec update

incident-bot: Added note: followups tagged model-calibration, rollout-safety, eval-thresholds.

Diego Mar: infra check: no serving runtime kernel changes in the past 24h. CI shows two training config commits merged 12h ago: train/ccf9b and train/ccf9c. Will prioritize bisect.

Priya Rao: starting bisect now. ETA ~50m for reduced commit range. Also checking any quantization/compile flags changed.

Aisha Khan: status draft for private page: "We observed an automated safety eval regression on model refusal-guard-x; traffic has been routed to a safe fallback and we're monitoring. Engineers are collecting examples and investigating root cause."

Connor Wu: uploading artifacts done. access: sec-s3://inc-9450/samples/failset-30.json

oncall-router: escalation timer paused. Keep monitoring for 30m. Handoff scheduled in 40m to daytime oncall.

Aisha Khan: note for handoff: keep safety alert threshold, keep routes on legacy, wait for Priya's bisect before any revert decision.

Priya Rao: (later) initial bisect points to commit train/ccf9b which modified refusal-head temperature scaling. Collecting more traces to confirm.\n
Aisha Khan: thanks team, will keep this thread as single source of truth. Re-page if rate creeps up. :thumbsup:
